summary: Google's AI research notebook that grounds answers in user-supplied sources, with an Enterprise API and MCP server to manage notebooks and sources.
access_note: Public Preview Gemini Notebook API is free to use during preview for personal Google Accounts: create a Google Cloud project, configure OAuth consent, create OAuth clients. The separate Enterprise REST API needs a Gemini Notebook Enterprise license.
blocker_note: Public Preview (pre-GA); personal Google Accounts only (Workspace accounts get 403); API covers notebooks and sources only (7 MCP tools).

evidence.quote: The Gemini Notebook API uses OAuth 2.0 to authenticate requests on behalf of a Google user.
The Gemini Notebook API is free to use during the Public Preview period
During the Public Preview, the Gemini Notebook API is only available for personal Google Accounts.
require an authenticated user account with an active Gemini Notebook Enterprise license
The Gemini Notebook API is a REST interface for programmatically creating and managing notebooks and sources in Gemini Notebook.
The Gemini Notebook API provides a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at https://notebook.googleapis.com/mcp

notes: Pass 1 used the Enterprise-licensed API page; Google also publishes the Gemini Notebook API at developers.google.com/notebook (REST + remote MCP, free during Public Preview, personal accounts only). Whether Google requires OAuth app verification for other users was not confirmed. Consumer NotebookLM has no separate API beyond this.
